'''Varda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who fought during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. During the war, Varda fell in love with a captive [[Dorjander Kace]] and became pregnant with his child. Varda died in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] bombing raid led by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], her now grieving lover resumed his place in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|War]].
